name: agent-runtime
description: A lightweight, zero-dependency Agent runtime for TypeScript/Node.js: event loop, tool-calling, multi-step reasoning and pluggable LLM providers. Organized as an npm-workspaces monorepo (packages/types · packages/core).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-runtime/types && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/memory && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/artifact && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/sandbox && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/policy && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/core && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/tools-basic && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/mock && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/host && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/mcp && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/provider-openai && npm run build -w @agent-runtime/store-sqlite
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agent-runtime/types && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/memory && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/artifact && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/sandbox && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/policy && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/core && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/tools-basic && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/mock && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/host && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/mcp && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/provider-openai && npm run test -w @agent-runtime/store-sqlite && npm run test:web-security
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run coverage:gate && npm run check:api
